intro.body1: History is not only found in books and monuments. It lives in streets, buildings, traditions and the memories people carry.

founder.title: Meet the Founder & Heritage Guide
founder.body: Kanhaiya Chouksey is a heritage walk organiser, storyteller and history enthusiast from Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh. Through Historyaddaa, he works to make the city’s history, heritage and lesser-known stories accessible through engaging storytelling and guided heritage walks.
founder.body2: He has experience organising and conducting heritage walks across Jabalpur and is actively involved in historical research and history-related content. His academic interests include ancient Indian history, anthropology and museology. Historyaddaa began with the belief that people should know the stories of their own hometown; it later grew into walks so participants could experience heritage first-hand.

about.title: About History Adda
about.subhead: The origin, mission, and approach behind Jabalpur’s guided heritage walks.

origin.title: Our Origin
origin.body: Historyaddaa began with a simple thought: people from every city have stories to tell about their hometown, and the people of Jabalpur should have those stories too. The initiative aims to make the city’s history, architecture, culture and forgotten stories accessible through storytelling, heritage walks and community participation.
